status: FROZEN by the freeze commit recorded in docs/worklogs/86_WORKLOG_ECRO_GLOBAL_RESPONSE.md (before any evidence run)
hypothesis: A compact, source-independent, geometry-conditioned learned linear operator can predict the higher-order directional transport generated by frozen ER and current geometry, generalise to unseen illumination and rigid edits, and give a quality-matched end-to-end advantage over full frozen-ER path tracing.

operator_contract.symbols: S_ER: frozen ER local scattering; C_G: free-space propagation in the current geometry; T_G = S_ER C_G; e_G: incident direct light of the emitters; q_G = S_ER e_G.
operator_contract.target: finite-depth series of the reference integrator, D = 6 scattering events: b_G = sum_{j=0}^{D-1} T_G^j q_G. LOW = q + T q; H_G[q] = sum_{j=2}^{D-1} T_G^j q.
operator_contract.event_correspondence: a camera path's next-event contribution at its k-th surface vertex contains exactly k scattering events and equals the camera readout of T^{k-1} q: e1 = q, e2 = T q, h = events 3..6 = H[q]. Mitsuba's path integrator with max_depth = k + 1 is the same truncation (test V1 at k = 6, 2, 1).
operator_contract.estimator: b_hat = q + T q + T_G R_theta(G, z_ER)[e]: the last flight T_G of the higher-order term is the physical bounce x1 -> x2 that LOW traces anyway; R_theta[e](x2, w) approximates sum_{j=1}^{D-2} T^j q, the radiance leaving x2 towards x1 made of 2..5 scattering events. So H_theta = T_G R_theta, read by the camera as throughput(x1) * B[patch(x2), bin(w)] with no additional ray.
operator_contract.ownership: ER owns every local scattering event that is evaluated physically (x1, and x2 for e2) and conditions the operator only through its frozen compiled states; current geometry owns visibility (camera ray, x1 -> x2 flight, light visibility of e1 / e2 and of the source encoding, the state rays); ECRO owns only paths with >= 3 scattering events. No double counting: B excludes the once-scattered radiance q of x2 (that is e2) and events > D - 1 at x2.
operator_contract.source_independence: the generator sees geometry, frozen ER states and state rays only; the source field enters exclusively through the linear application B = K_theta(G, z) s with non-negative coefficients (zero input -> zero, exact superposition, non-negative response). No pose index, source identity, reference radiance or target coefficient is a runtime input.
operator_contract.not_imposed: no single-scattering passivity / row-sum constraint on the multi-flight response; its energy is compared with the path-traced field instead (contracts: flux ratio).

fixture.units: metres, z up; room x,y in [-2,2], z in [0,3], open towards -y; camera outside the opening
fixture.rationale: semi-enclosed room so that >= 3-event transport is a meaningful part of the radiance; stationary sharp panel and moderate sphere; two movable Lambert boxes whose rigid edits move direct shadows, enable / block light -> panel -> receiver paths and change what the panel and sphere reflect. WL85's open fixture is development evidence only (its H share is 3 %).

E1.role: primary edit; inspected during development (look renders, dev oracle projection, dev-model renders at T1); final evidence uses fresh seeds and the frozen models

E2.role: independent held-out geometry / edit (translation + rotation of the other box) / light. Excluded from training by the margins; masks, thresholds and the representation were fixed without it. Disclosure: the end-to-end dev smoke of the chain (128 spp, 600-step throwaway models) also ran E2 and its noise-dominated aggregate numbers were seen; they were used for one decision only, the REF-P replica count (4 -> 8), so that the change of the higher-order term can be resolved. No high-sample E2 radiance exists before the frozen chain.

fixture.held_out_sources: LMIX (two coloured lights at unseen positions: incident mixture) and LSPOT (hard-edged cone: a source class never used in training) on the E1 T1 geometry

representation.family: patch x outgoing-direction-bin table of the higher-order outgoing radiance (2..5 scattering events), produced by a non-negative linear operator from the patch x incident-direction-bin direct irradiance
representation.patches: 1270: 25 cm grid on floor / ceiling / walls, 20 cm on the panel, 3 x 3 per box face, 8 x 4 equal-area on the sphere; piecewise constant, nearest patch
representation.bins_note: 64 equal-solid-angle bins of the patch-local hemisphere (4 rings in cos(theta) x 16 azimuth sectors), piecewise constant
representation.state: per patch 512 stratified hemisphere rays (8 per incident bin): hit patch, outgoing bin at the hit patch, segment (for the dirty test); patch tables
representation.not_changed_after_freeze: bins, patches, channel / rank sizes, network, loss, schedule, data sizes

regions.definition: geometry / visibility only (masks86.py): A direct-visibility change; Bset stationary with unchanged direct visibility; C = Bset in a light -> panel -> receiver mirror footprint enabled / blocked by the edit, or a panel / sphere receiver whose mirror cone sees a changed hit; D = Bset, not C, broad receiver, exposure u >= u_hi; E = Bset, not C, u <= u_lo

architecture.description: patch features (centroid, frame, area, frozen ER state through an MLP, openness) -> tokens; 3 rounds of message passing over the state-ray form-factor matrix + global mean; heads: c (incident bin -> 16 channels), a (16 channels -> outgoing bin), global encoder Q / decoder P (rank 24), all softplus (>= 0), per colour channel. Application: single learned flight through the state rays (current visibility) + low-rank global term (model86.py).

training.loss: squared error relative to the target's patch mean over bins (+ 5 % of the field mean); Adam, gradient clip 10, one geometry (4 lightings) per step
training.supervision: path-traced frozen-ER field (2..5 scattering events) per patch and outgoing bin, single white point lights; no image, no test configuration
training.exclusion: a training / validation geometry is rejected if either box centre is within 0.15 m of that box's centre in any of E1 T0 / T1, E2 T0 / T1; a light if within 0.3 m of any test light position
training.development: architecture, loss and schedule were fixed with a 48-geometry dev split (seed 86300; 40 train / 8 val, 4,000 steps) and E1 T1 dev renders; the dev model is not used in the evidence run

references.common_random_numbers: T0 and T1 of an edit share seeds; replicas are independent
references.estimator: next-event estimation to every light at each of <= 6 vertices, BSDF sampling, no Russian roulette

stage0.criteria_on: REF-P (class shares: REF-ER); 'rel' = relative to the region mean of REF-P at T0; noise floor = half the mean absolute difference of the two replica halves

criteria.Q1: A: mean |change| >= A_min and >= snr x floor
criteria.Q2: Bset: mean |change| >= B_min and >= snr x floor (indirect response on stationary receivers with unchanged direct visibility)
criteria.Q3: C: >= min_pixels, mean |change| >= C_min and >= snr x floor, and sharp / moderate involvement >= C_sm_share_min of the absolute CHANGE of the >= 2-event radiance in C (REF-ER class channels, T1 - T0 with common random numbers; panel / sphere receivers count fully, otherwise the sender-class S / M channels)
criteria.Q4: D: mean |change| >= D_min and >= snr x floor; mean |change of the >= 3-event part| >= D_H_ratio_min x mean |change| and >= snr x its floor
criteria.Q5: E: >= min_pixels and mean |change| <= E_max_ratio_to_D x that of D (control class; if it fails, class E is reported NOT AVAILABLE for that edit - not an admission criterion)
criteria.Q6: >= 3-event share of the T1 stationary radiance >= H_share_min
criteria.Q7: split-half relative L1 uncertainty of REF-P and REF-ER on the stationary pixels <= uncertainty_max

stage0.admission: E1 and E2 must each pass Q1-Q4, Q6, Q7 and the validation tests; otherwise STOPPED_UNQUALIFIED_WORKLOAD (code note: analyze86.py qualify applies this rule; Q5 is reported)

stage1.measure: E_H(X) = sum |hl_X - h_REF-ER| / sum tot_REF-ER over a region (the LOW estimator is shared, so this is the additional error of the higher-order term relative to total radiance); H share = E_H of LOW alone; capture = E_H / H share
stage1.I1: H share >= max(H_share_min, snr x reference uncertainty) on the stationary pixels and >= H_share_min in D, for E1 and E2; else STOPPED_HIGH_ORDER_BENEFIT_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE
stage1.I2: the change of the higher-order term in D is resolvable (>= snr x floor); if not, the dynamic gate F3 is INDETERMINATE for that edit (no stop)
stage1.R1: oracle projection (path-traced patch x bin field, diagnostic, not a runtime input): E_H <= oracle_EH_stationary_max and capture <= oracle_capture_max on the stationary pixels (T0 and T1), and E_H <= oracle_EH_region_max in A, C, D, for E1 and E2; else STOPPED_REPRESENTATION_INADEQUATE

ecro_render.variants: ecro (all configurations and held-out sources); stale, nog (no global term), nos (no single-flight term) at T1

stage3.contracts: ecro86.py contracts must PASS for every seed: zero input, non-negativity, determinism, superposition and scaling (<= 1e-4), directional distinction (two equal-irradiance spots on the panel: model distance >= half the path-traced distance and matched < swapped errors), selective state update == full rebuild == fresh scene, move-and-return and null edit state identity
stage3.G1: field level: validation relative L1 <= val_over_train_max x that of the high-quality training subset (same target noise)
stage3.F1: E_H <= EH_stationary_max and capture <= capture_max on the stationary pixels, T0 and T1, E1 and E2
stage3.F2: E_H <= EH_region_max in A, C and D at T1, E1 and E2
stage3.F3: change of the higher-order term in D (ECRO T1 - T0 vs REF-ER, common random numbers): slope in dH_slope and correlation >= dH_corr_min when I2 holds
stage3.F4: E_H <= EH_unseen_source_max on the stationary pixels for LMIX and LSPOT (E1 T1 geometry)
stage3.F5: STALE control (T0 response state with the current source field): a valid update is shown to matter if STALE's E_H is >= stale_ratio_min x ECRO's in at least one of A, C, D, panel, sphere, static boxes; reported, qualifies the edit-response verdict, does not fail ECRO
stage3.status: PASS (both seeds satisfy G1, F1, F2, F4 and no F3 FAIL); PASS_ONE_SEED; STOPPED_GENERALIZATION_NOT_SUPPORTED if no seed passes although the high-quality training subset is fitted (relative L1 <= train_field_fit_max); otherwise FIDELITY_NOT_SUPPORTED (learning / capacity, attributed from the oracle ceiling and the training fit)

stage4.comparator: plain full path tracing with the same frozen ER (primary physical computation comparator); not a neural baseline: no Neural Full Recompute or Native Reuse claim is made
stage4.quality: relative L1 of the full image against the pooled REF-ER image of T1 on the stationary pixels; levels 0.10, 0.05, 0.03 and g (measured REF-ER vs REF-P gap of the edit); region-matched if ECRO's interpolated errors in A, C, D are <= region_tolerance x the path tracer's
stage4.costs: ECRO per edit: in-place geometry update, selective state rays (full rebuild reported separately as FULL-STATE), source encoding, generator + application, table transfer, first-frame acceleration-structure cost; per frame: LOW + lookup render. Path tracer per edit: geometry update + first-frame cost; per frame: render. Kernel GPU time and wall-clock; cold initialisation; memory; second view; offline data / training cost reported separately with its amortisation
stage4.verdict: SUPPORTED: edit-to-first-frame advantage >= advantage_min in wall-clock and kernel GPU time at 0.05, 0.03 and g with region-matched quality, on E1 and E2; CONDITIONALLY SUPPORTED: at 0.05 and 0.03 only, or resident per-frame only; NOT SUPPORTED otherwise (ECONOMICS_NOT_SUPPORTED); NOT TESTED if stage 3 fails (costs are then reported descriptively)

verdict_mapping.REPRESENTABILITY: SUPPORTED if R1 passes on E1 and E2; NOT SUPPORTED if it fails
verdict_mapping.GENERALIZATION: SUPPORTED if G1, F1, F2, F4 hold for both seeds; CONDITIONALLY for one seed or without F4; NOT SUPPORTED otherwise
verdict_mapping.PHYSICAL FIDELITY: ECRO's additional error (F1, F2) reported separately from the REF-ER vs REF-P gap g; SUPPORTED if F1 and F2 hold for both seeds on both edits
verdict_mapping.DYNAMIC EDIT RESPONSE: SUPPORTED if F3 passes on both edits and F5 shows the update matters; CONDITIONALLY if F3 passes but F5 does not, or on one edit; INDETERMINATE if not resolvable
verdict_mapping.GM1 ARCHITECTURE VIABILITY: SUPPORTED only if all of the above are SUPPORTED within the declared scope (one room family, rigid box edits, three ER materials, point / spot sources, 512^2); otherwise the weakest label with its cause

scope_limits: one scene family with fixed stationary geometry and materials; material generalisation, non-rigid edits, area lights, other resolutions are NOT TESTED
